_note: Fixture data for the Week 7 agent exercise, extended in Week 8 with a manager_comment field. Not real employees, and the jurisdiction rules are invented for the exercise rather than legal fact. manager_comment is free text a manager typed: it is the one field in this fixture that nobody in this repo controls the wording of, which is why injection_probe.py attacks through it. The committed comments are all benign; the poisoned one is injected at run time so that no eval can be run against a poisoned record by accident.
